objective: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

description: The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.
<name>, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. You will find them just to the west of here.
completion: <name>, I thank you... but I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.
